title: PublicKeys
description: A lab's public keys, as the JSON document the lab publishes.

PublicKey.description: One of a lab's public keys.

algorithm.description:
The key's algorithm: `ed25519`. A verifier leaves out a key of an algorithm that it does
not know.

created_at.description: When the lab made the key: RFC 3339.

key_id.description: The first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

public_key.description: The raw 32 bytes of the public key, in base64url with no padding.

retired_at.description:
When the lab stopped signing with the key: RFC 3339. Null while the lab still signs with
it. A retired key still verifies a receipt that was issued before this time.
